انضويت (form VII)
# اِنْضَوَيْتُ (inḍawaytu) /in.dˤa.waj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْضَوَى (inḍawā)
# اِنْضَوَيْتَ (inḍawayta) /in.dˤa.waj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْضَوَى (inḍawā)
# اِنْضَوَيْتِ (inḍawayti) /in.dˤa.waj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْضَوَى (inḍawā)
